description: This file implements a service class 'SambaNovaLLMService' that extends 'OpenAILLMService' to facilitate interaction with SambaNova's LLM API using an OpenAI-compatible interface. The class provides methods for initializing the service, creating a client, building chat completion parameters, and processing streaming chat responses, including handling function calls and streamed text. It is specifically tailored for SambaNova's API endpoint and custom behavior.
